smart_port.title: Connect to Sigen Cloud
smart_port.description: Enter the same username/password you use in the mySigen app, plus your station ID and region. Find your station ID in the mySigen app URL or by asking your installer.

data.load_path: Load Path (leave as 1 unless you have multiple Smart Port loads)
data.name: Name for this device

smart_port_advanced.title: Advanced settings
smart_port_advanced.description: The API base URL below is only used if Region is set to Custom - otherwise it's set automatically from your region. Only change the other defaults if you know you need to.

data.base_url: API base URL (only used if Region = Custom)
data.profile_refresh_days: Refresh full Energy Profile list every (days)

ac_charger.title: Connect your AC Charger to Sigen Cloud
ac_charger.description: Enter the same username/password you use in the mySigen app, your station ID, region, and the charger's serial number (shown on the charger screen in the app, e.g. under Device Info).

ac_charger_advanced.title: Advanced settings
ac_charger_advanced.description: The API base URL below is only used if Region is set to Custom - otherwise it's set automatically from your region. Only change the other defaults if you know you need to.

data.base_url: API base URL (only used if Region = Custom)

error.cannot_connect: Couldn't log in or read status. Double-check your username, password, station ID, region, and (for chargers) the serial number.

abort.already_configured: This device is already set up.

init.title: Sigen Smart Port options
init.description: How often Home Assistant polls the Sigen cloud for this device's real state. Lower values catch changes faster but log in more often - the default of 300s (5 minutes) is a sensible balance.

data.base_url: API base URL (only used if Region = Custom)
data.profile_refresh_days: Refresh full Energy Profile list every (days)
